source: Formulas.calcAtkSpd(attacker, skill, skillTime) and the cast / reuse numbers of Creature.beginCast
note: calc_atk_spd is the real Formulas.calcAtkSpd(creature, skill, hit_time + cool_time). cast_time and reuse_delay REPLAY the pure-number lines of Creature.beginCast (the method itself needs a world): skillTime = hit + cool; non-static skills go through calcAtkSpd; magic skills with charged sps / bss x0.6 (int); then the 550 ms (magic, base > 550) / 500 ms (non-static, base >= 500) floors; reuse_delay = (int)(reuse * MAGIC_REUSE_RATE | P_REUSE | DANCE_REUSE) unless static reuse / static skill, then (int)(x * SKILL_REUSE_MULTIPLIERS[class]) for players (1.0). The stat calls and calcAtkSpd are the real code. shots = the creature's charged shots when the case ran (a creature without a weapon cannot hold any). reuse_with_mastery is the reuse a mastered cast gets (100) when reuse_delay > 10.
